What happened?

AoS sequence

Quick rules

  1. Reveal a Program and its Limitation together.
  2. Apply the Limitation, then commit every required-color die and allocate the remaining dice.
  3. Finish allocating all five colors, then roll each element.
  4. Each element gets one roll. Extra STR rolls are shared across the Program and replace the entire result.
  5. Resolve the gradient: exact Target recovers 2; +1 is free; +2 or more exhausts 1; failure exhausts all. Dice beyond Target +1 also exhaust.
  6. Two or more failed elements cost 1 HP. Recover REC dice after every Program.

The app automates dice results and deck progression but leaves card-specific abilities, required-color checks, and reward choices in your hands.
